capabilities: Subscribe to RSS, Atom and WeChat public accounts
Read and bookmark articles in a sidebar reader
Archive articles as Markdown notes with YAML metadata
Manage subscriptions with search, grouping and pause
disambiguation: Not WeChat-only: standard RSS and Atom feeds work without the optional WeChat engine.
extras: WeChat support is macOS Apple Silicon only and needs an explicitly confirmed ~45.5 MiB engine download plus a local companion process; credentials, caches and collection state are stored outside the vault. RSS and Atom work without it. No telemetry or paid features.
problem: Obsidian cannot follow feeds or WeChat public accounts, so articles read there cannot be kept as notes in the vault.

relations.evidence: The legacy collector retains the MIT attribution of wechat-mp-tools.

summary: Sidebar RSS, Atom and WeChat public-account reader that bookmarks articles and archives them as Markdown notes.
